VR.title: Quest 3 Headsets Are Heading To The International Space Station
VR.summary: Two Quest 3 headsets are heading to the International Space Station to assist astronauts in training for spacewalks, in collaboration with Meta and the ESA.

VR.title: KRVR Supports Apple Vision Pro's Foveated Streaming For SteamVR Games
VR.summary: KRVR, a new $15 visionOS app, enables users to play SteamVR games on Apple Vision Pro with foveated streaming technology.

VR.summary: James Cameron’s Lightstorm Vision has acquired 3D camera maker STEREOTEC to enhance its film and immersive concert productions.

VR.title: Trombone Champ: Unflattened & Maskmaker Coming To Meta Horizon+ This Month
VR.summary: Meta's subscription service, Horizon+, is set to launch new games including Trombone Champ: Unflattened and Maskmaker this month.

VR.title: PlayStation VR2 Gets A Discount For Sony PlayStation Days Of Play
VR.summary: PlayStation VR2 is available at a $100 discount during Sony's Days of Play event, running from May 27 to June 10.

VR.title: Spatial Is Discontinuing Its Creator Platform In July
VR.summary: Spatial is discontinuing its creator platform to focus on original IP development, marking a significant shift in its business strategy.

AI.summary: Microsoft Scout, an always-on AI personal assistant, integrates with Microsoft 365 apps to streamline tasks for employees.

AI.summary: Microsoft announced Project Solara, a new operating system designed specifically for gadgets running AI agents, at its Build 2026 conference.

AI.summary: Google's Phone app will now alert users if a scammer attempts to impersonate their contacts, enhancing security against AI-related fraud.

AI.title: Microsoft Build 2026: The 7 biggest announcements
AI.summary: Microsoft Build 2026 kicked off with major announcements, including new hardware and updates across its AI models and services.

NFL.summary: Rams head coach Sean McVay expressed interest in bringing back Aaron Donald if he decides to return to the team.

NFL.summary: The 49ers signed safety Ashtyn Davis to a one-year contract, bolstering their defensive lineup.

NFL.summary: Justin Herbert is revamping his footwork to improve his release speed under the guidance of offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel.

NFL.summary: NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell will decline an invitation to testify on the Sports Broadcasting Act, as requested by the House Judiciary Committee.
